contentHtml:
Desktop | Laptop | Mac Upgrades

Desiring to have a better performance for your desktop, laptop or Mac? Computer Repairs Stretton is always here to help you in your desktop, laptop and Mac upgrades and enhancing your machine’s performance, saving your money for trying to buy a new one.

We do acknowledge that we live in financially tiring times and the impact of inflation on our lives is quite intensive. Following the conventional wisdom to simply purchase a new machine whenever the old one is becoming poor in performance seems not an easy choice for most people. Upgrading your machine can often be a far more affordable solution.

When it comes to computer upgrades and performance improvements, Computer Repairs Stretton is your perfect go-to computer service. We are expert on all kinds of computer upgrades, whether you have a brand new computer or a year-old system, we can help.

Our desktop laptop Mac upgrades Stretton service

  • Computer reformatting
  • Computer tune-up
  • Hardware installs
  • Laptop upgrades
  • Mac upgrades
  • PC upgrades
  • Operating System Installation
  • Optimization
  • Performance Speedup

Unlike most desktop computers, not every component on laptops can be upgraded. Some of the upgrades can also void the computer’s warranty. Our experts will provide you a very accurate, honest and comprehensive information to help you decide on pursuing the upgrade or to resort in buying a new one instead. We could also assist you in creating repair reports for warranty and insurance reports for faster approval of your insurance company.

At Computer Repairs Stretton, we always make sure that all the hardware component replacement and upgrades are guaranteed to be 100% compatible with your current hardware configuration. Give us a call at 0477 319 160 and we will deliver the best upgrade for your computer system, optimizing its performance at its peak. Our workshop is open 7 days a week from 7am up to 10pm and even on holidays. Our team are also happy to provide you an onsite service to save you from traveling your computer to us, instead we will bring our service to you. Our service is available for all the residents and small businesses in Stretton as well as nearby Brisbane suburbs.

You can always read our customer reviews and you will be confident that your desktop or laptop is handled by expert and trustworthy professionals. We make sure that you are always informed all thru out the upgrade process. Our service will never have hidden charges and other unpleasant surprises that may shock you when you received your billing statement. We always ask for our customer’s approval before making any purchase on additional software or hardware components. All the software and hardware parts installed on your system are covered by manufacturer warranty.

Computer Repairs Stretton never fails to deliver an honest, professional, friendly and most affordable computer repair service in Stretton.
